commit_message:
Use signature-based trust for package name overrides

Shift the trust model for EXTRA_PACKAGE_NAME overrides from installation status (FLAG_SYSTEM) to cryptographic signatures. Only packages signed with core system certificates are now
permitted to override the calling package name.
